The '''''Enemy of the Order: The record of [[Parlan Spinner]], vandal and would-be revolutionary''''' was a report filed by [[Tahv Constabulary]] [[Prefect of Police|Prefect]] [[Takara Hilts]] in [[2974 BBY]] at the [[Tribal Intelligence Depository]] in [[Orreg]]. The report was sent to [[Grand Consort]] [[Iliana Hilts]], her mother and the wife of [[High Lord]] [[Varner Hilts]]. It dealt with the threat posed by the robber and vandal "Death Spinner," an enemy of the ruling [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] elite on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. This report was filed into the archives one week before his arrest and banishment from [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]]. It gave a biographical sketch of Spinner including his criminal activities and recommended either killing or capturing him.

==Behind the scenes==
''Enemy of the Order'' was included as an extant plot element within [[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 2|''Lost Tribe of the Sith—Spiral'' 2]], which debuted on [[September 12]], [[2012]].
